Name: Adventure Time hairstyles
Author: peroxidewren
Description:
[size=4][center][b]Adventure Time hairstyles[/b]​[/center][/size][center][img]http://community.playstarbound.com/attachments/all-at-hair-gif.177821/[/img] [/center]
​I love Adventure Time to bits so decided that it would be fun to make a few mods that make the player look like AT characters.

Included here are twelve new hairstyles:
[b]#17[/b]- Finn's hat, no hair
[b]#18[/b]- Finn's hat, with hair
[b]#19[/b]- Prince Gumball
[b]#33[/b]- Fionna's hat
[b]#34[/b]- Fionna, hair down, bunny hairband
[b]#35[/b]- Princess Bubblegum, hair down
[b]#36[/b]- Princess Bubblegum, hair up
[b]#37[/b]- PB, hair down, no colour
[b]#38[/b]- PB, hair down, no colour, darker outlines
[b]#39[/b]- Marceline, hair down
[b]#40[/b]- Marceline, half shaved
[b]#41[/b]- Marceline, ponytail
[b]#42[/b]- Flame Princess

[center][img]http://community.playstarbound.com/attachments/all-at-hair-png.177822/[/img] [/center]
[url=http://community.playstarbound.com/attachments/at-hairstyles-png.177823/][img]http://community.playstarbound.com/data/attachments/177/177834-b210349eb513e549221b74735c4cf257.jpg[/img][/url]


[b]Some things to know:[/b]
[font=Lucida Sans Unicode]-For hairstyles with accessories (hats/ crowns/ tiaras), the hair colour slider needs to be as white and bright as possible in order for the hairstyle to be the right colour.[/font]
[font=Lucida Sans Unicode]-None of these hairstyles replace any of the vanilla hairstyles.[/font]
[font=Lucida Sans Unicode]-Depending on how many hairstyles I have added, there may be bald hairstyles at the end, this is normal.[/font]

[b]To install:[/b]
[font=Lucida Sans Unicode]Add the .xnb file from this download to Stardew Valley\Content\Characters\Farmer (Remember to rename the .xnb file to hairstyles.xnb). Also it might be a good idea to make a backup of the vanilla hairstyles.xnb file).[/font]
